restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text: I had a teeth cleaning here. Both doctors are very nice and spoke English to me. I was very satisfied with the cleaning and plan on coming back again soon.

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text:
I've been here many times, for root canal treatment and tooth extractions.
The prices are reasonable, and the dentist gives good advice.
They explain which tooth needs what treatment and how to treat it. …

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text:
Terrible. The female doctor had a awful attitude. I was in pain, so I raised my hand. It hurt so much, and she said, "You're overacting." What the hell?
She sighed, then used the drip bottle to scrape my mouth. I couldn't speak, and she kept scraping until it was raw. I took pictures. I'm thinking about filing a police report. I went for wisdom tooth treatment, and now the outside of my mouth is all scraped up. What the hell did you do? It's clear she was acting emotional. She was a total jerk. I'm not giving up. I made a huge mistake going there. I was in so much pain, I had no choice but to go to a clinic near my house. Terrible luck to encounter a doctor like this.

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text:
I went to get my wisdom teeth extracted. I told them it hurt, so they pulled it out for me.
They didn't force me to do anything else, like some clinics do. It was good.
author_name: กิตติญา เที่ยงธรรม

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text: Excellent service. I've been to many places, but this place is very attentive. After extracting my molar, they even stitched the wound closed. I used my social security insurance.

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text:
I had it done a long, long time ago, and it was terrible. Completely unprofessional, just for one molar, by a male dentist.
It hurt so much; he injected the local anesthetic into the tooth socket – I remember it vividly.

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text: Terrible! Just a filling, and it's causing pain and sensitivity... The dental room is also filthy. They did minor work, charged my deposit, and even made me pay extra... In short, it's a terrible and very dirty clinic. I made a mistake going in.

restaurant_name: คลินิกรุ่งเจริญทันตแพทย์
text: Terrible service. The female doctor needs to improve her communication with clients. Some clients aren't getting free treatment; they're paying, but she acts like she's just going through the motions. If she doesn't want to treat clients' teeth, she should quit being a doctor.
